description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the AttendancePunchInRecordOverlapAPI in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing the API endpoints related to punch-in record overlaps for attendance. It includes test methods for 'getOne' and checks for not implemented methods like 'update', 'delete', and their validation rules.
